ḥꜣt-ꜥ: ḥꜣt-ꜥ — beginning, start, especially of a book or list (compound noun of ḥꜣt 'front' and ꜥ 'arm'; ḥꜣt-ꜥ m 'the beginning of')
sṯs: sṯs — to raise up, lift; to extol, praise (verb; causative of ṯs 'raise')
sꜣḫ: sꜣḫ — to glorify, make (someone) an ꜣḫ, an effective spirit (verb; causative of ꜣḫ); sꜣḫw 'glorifications', the recitations that do this for the dead (noun, plural)
smꜣꜥ-ḫrw: smꜣꜥ-ḫrw — to make true of voice, to vindicate, justify (verb; causative of mꜣꜥ-ḫrw 'true of voice'; smꜣꜥ-ḫrw N r 'vindicate N against')
imḏw: imḏw — a word for a person or a god, perhaps a title; reading and meaning unknown (noun, with the classifiers of a man and a god; Budge: àmṭu, 'advocate', a guess from the sense)
ḫnr: ḫnr — to restrain, hold back, shut in (verb)

__broaden__.ꜣḫ: ꜣḫ — spirit, the glorified and effective dead (noun; written with the crested ibis) · also glory, effective power (noun m.) · also glorious, effective (adjective)
__broaden__.ḥr: ḥr — face; (preposition) upon, on, over, concerning · a second word of the same spelling: Horus, the falcon god, son of Osiris and Isis; the sun as a falcon (god's name; Budge: Ḥeru) · also 'at' (ḥr sbꜣw 'at the gates'); ḥr-tp 'upon' (compound preposition: ḥr + tp 'head') · also for, on behalf of; on account of (preposition; ḥr·k 'for you')
